story.raid_sighted: Smoke on the horizon, to the %s. Raiders, %s of them by the look of it. They will be on us within %s hours. Guard the store.
story.raid_arrived: They're here! They're making for the store!
story.raid_plundered: They took what they could carry and ran. Half our food is gone.
story.raid_driven_off: We drove them off. The store is safe.
story.winter_warning: Winter is one season away. To get through it we need about %s meals in the store. We have %s.
story.winter_came: Winter is here. Nothing will grow out in the fields until spring.
story.act_one_survived: %s lived through its first winter. Act I is complete.
story.act_one_lost: %s is lost. No one is left.
story.why.stolen: - Raiders carried off food on day %s (#%s).
story.why.warned: - On day %s you were told winter needed %s meals; the store held %s (#%s).
story.why.more: Type /roe why %s to see everything that led here.
advice.raid: Raiders are coming: %s of them, %s hours away. Stand between them and the store.
advice.granary: We have nowhere to keep food. Put a Granary Seal by some chests and that will be our store.
advice.farm: We can't live on what we carried. Lay out a farm blueprint and we'll build it.
advice.farmer: The fields need tending. Ask one of us to farm.
advice.builder: The blueprint won't build itself. Ask one of us to build.
advice.bunkhouse: We're sleeping on the ground. A bunkhouse would keep us on our feet.
advice.food: We have %s meals put by. Winter will want %s. We need more in the store before the frost.
advice.unwell: %s is %s. They need food and a bed.
